Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer repeatedly failed to retrieve a direct, explicit citation from Plants of the World Online (POWO) or any other authoritative source confirming Huernia as a genus. Despite multiple attempts, the searches only yielded species pages or indirect mentions of "Genus Huernia" without securing a definitive genus-page citation. This oversight led to an incomplete verification of Huernia's status as a genus, which is crucial for answering the real-world problem accurately.
